entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Writ Petition has been filed for the issue of Writ of Mandamus directing the first respondent to pass orders on the representation made by the petitioner on 25.05.2020, wherein, the petitioner has sought for reviewing the modified award dated 22.09.2017 within a time frame fixed by this Court.

2.When the matter came up for hearing on 19.10.2023, this Court has passed the following order:
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
The specific case that has been pleaded by the petitioner is that the Competent Authority has passed a Modification Award on 22.09.2017.

As against the same, the petitioner has filed an independent application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 before the first respondent District Collector and no orders have been passed in that application till date.

2.The third respondent has filed a counter affidavit and has taken a stand that the Award has already been passed by the first respondent District Collector/Arbitrator on 08.01.2019 and the compensation was enhanced and enhanced compensation amount was also paid to the petitioner through ECS Cheque dated 16.03.2020.
Therefore, the third respondent has taken a specific stand that nothing survives for adjudication in the present Writ Petition.

If at all the petitioner is aggrieved by the order passed by the first respondent District Collector, only application under Section 34(3) of the Arbitration Act, 1996 should be filed before the Competent Court.
3.When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the proceedings of the District Collector/Arbitrator dated 08.01.2019 was placed before this Court.

It is seen from this proceedings that the petitioner, namely, R.Vijaya had participated in the proceedings and the claim made by the petitioner was also considered and her statement was also recorded and thereafter, the arbitration order was passed through proceedings dated 08.01.2019.

The enhanced amount of Rs.1,35,247/-
was also paid to the petitioner on 16.03.2020.
